name: Ezz Steel
source: Ezz Steel Company (SAE) Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, audited, consolidated statement of income, printed in EGP thousands and stored here in absolute EGP
note: Consolidated statement of income, absolute EGP (the audited statement prints EGP thousands). Operating Expenses is selling and marketing plus general and administrative plus other operating expenses. Operating Profit (EBIT) is derived as gross profit plus other operating revenues less operating expenses, which reproduces the printed operating profit of 33640236000 (FY2023) and 15346995000 (FY2022). Income Tax is stored as printed net of deferred tax and is negative in FY2023 because it is a net credit: current tax expense 3745659000 less deferred tax asset 4012487000. The issuer's investor relations page publishes consolidated financial statements up to Q2 2024 only, so FY2024 and FY2025 are not available from the issuer.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
